newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Sellers emerge in WorldCom.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Sellers emerge in WorldCom.

text.p: Sellers were out in force in options on shares of WorldCom Inc as the stock attempted to extend its recent rally, traders said on Thursday.
"There are more sellers right now than there are buyers of options, probably because the stock's up," said a market maker in WorldCom options.
By the close, WorldCom had pared earlier gains to finish up 1/4 at 31-3/4. It rallied intraday nearly a point to 32-31/64. Turnover was heavy at more than 11.2 million shares.
The market maker said that one investor, in particular, who had put on a bullish spread a weak ago that involved buying the June 30 calls, was selling part of that that position out
Those purchases were made June 13 when the stock was trying to crack the 30 level and the options traded between 5/8 and 13/16.
The WorldCom June 30 calls, which traded more than 9,600 contracts on Thursday, ended down 1/16 at 1-11/16 after climbing to 2-3/4.
It had open interest of 22,488 contracts through Wednesday.
"There are a lot of spreads that are trading," the market maker said, adding that one investor was a big seller of the June 32-1/2 and July 32-1/2 calls.
The June 32-1/2 calls traded more than 1,900 contracts and the July 32-1/2s traded 6,855.
Other busy Worldcom options included the September 35 call, with turnover of 7,400 contracts and the December 35 call, which traded nearly 1,200.
The busiest WorldCom put was the July 32-1/2 with volume of about 1,070.
One options dealer said the selling in WorldCom options helped push volatilities up a few points.
In other activity, institutional investors were big buyers of the 3Com Corp July 45 calls, which traded about 11,075 contracts.
"It doesn't seem like unusual behavior," a market maker in the options said of the activity in the July 45 calls.
"Essentially the stock's going up and people are looking to take advantage of it," he said.
3Com, which last week closed its merger with U.S. Robotics Corp which ended up 1-13/16 at 48-3/4 on 9.3 million shrs.
Other busy 3Com options included the July 50 puts, which traded about 3,450 contracts and the July 45 puts, which traded 2,630.
